civil_comments.system: You are a careful content moderation annotator. You answer with one JSON object and nothing else.
civil_comments.definition: A document is toxic if a reasonable reader would call it rude, disrespectful, or likely to make someone leave the conversation. Use 1 for toxic and 0 for not toxic.
civil_comments.joint_instruction: Label each of the {n} documents below for toxicity.

ag_news.system: You are a careful news topic annotator. You answer with one JSON object and nothing else.
ag_news.definition: Assign each document to exactly one topic. Use 0 for World, 1 for Sports, 2 for Business and 3 for Sci/Tech.
ag_news.joint_instruction: Label each of the {n} documents below for topic.

multi_nli.system: You are a careful natural language inference annotator. You answer with one JSON object and nothing else.
multi_nli.definition: For each document, decide whether the hypothesis follows from the premise. Use 0 for entailment, 1 for neutral and 2 for contradiction.
multi_nli.joint_instruction: Label each of the {n} premise and hypothesis pairs below.
multi_nli.single_instruction: Label one premise and hypothesis pair.

imdb.system: You are a careful movie-review sentiment annotator. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.
imdb.definition: Classify the overall sentiment of each movie review. Use 0 for negative and 1 for positive.
imdb.joint_instruction: Label each of the {n} reviews below for overall sentiment.
imdb.single_instruction: Label one review for overall sentiment.

conditions.joint: Show all documents in a group and request every label in one response.
conditions.exact_context: Show the same documents in the same order and request one target label per independent response.
conditions.solo: Show one document and request one label; used only for the fake-batch negative control.

recovery.scope: 1095 initially malformed or truncated calls in the repeated-sampling experiment
